title: Settings

general.port_hint: TCP port the Sublarr server listens on. Requires restart to take effect.
general.api_key_hint: Protects all API endpoints. Leave empty to disable authentication.
general.log_level_hint: Controls server log verbosity. Use DEBUG only for troubleshooting — it generates large log files.
general.media_path_hint: Root directory where your media library is stored.
general.db_path_hint: Path to the SQLite database file. Changing this requires manually moving the existing file.
general.scan_engine_hint: Tool used to probe video file metadata. Auto selects the best available.
general.log_format_hint: json is useful for log aggregation tools. text is human-readable.
general.cors_origins_hint: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins. Only needed when accessing Sublarr from a different domain.
general.db_pool_size_hint: Maximum number of SQLite connections in the pool.
general.redis_url_hint: Redis connection URL. Leave empty to use the built-in in-memory queue.
general.plugins_dir_hint: Directory where Sublarr looks for installed plugins.

automation.upgrade_enabled_hint: Automatically replace subtitles with better-scoring ones when found.

automation.upgrade_window_hint: Only upgrade subtitles downloaded within this many days.

wanted_tab.scan_interval_hint: How often Sublarr scans the library for new media without subtitles. Set to 0 to disable.
wanted_tab.scan_on_startup_hint: Immediately scan the entire library when Sublarr starts.
wanted_tab.search_interval_hint: How often Sublarr searches providers for items in the Wanted list. Set to 0 to disable.
wanted_tab.search_on_startup_hint: Search providers for all Wanted items when Sublarr starts.
wanted_tab.max_search_attempts_hint: Stop automatically searching after this many failed attempts. The item stays in Wanted and can be searched manually.
wanted_tab.skip_srt_hint: When no ASS subtitle is found, do not download an SRT fallback. Useful for anime.
wanted_tab.anime_only_hint: Restrict library scanning to Sonarr entries tagged as anime.
wanted_tab.anime_movies_hint: Include Radarr entries tagged as anime in anime-only scans.
wanted_tab.max_items_per_run_hint: Limit how many Wanted items are processed per search cycle.
wanted_tab.backoff_base_hint: Multiplier for wait time between retries. Higher values mean longer gaps.
wanted_tab.backoff_cap_hint: Maximum wait time in hours between retry attempts.

automation_page.scan_interval_hint: How often (in hours) Sublarr scans the library for new files. 0 = event-driven only.
automation_page.scan_on_startup_hint: Automatically scan the library when Sublarr starts.
automation_page.max_items_per_run_hint: Maximum number of wanted items processed in a single search run.
automation_page.search_order_hint: Controls the order in which the scheduled search worker processes the queue. Fair Rotation is the default and ensures no item gets starved.
automation_page.stretch_mode_hint: Distributes the daily API budget. 'Stretch' paces evenly across 24h, 'Burst' runs at full rate for N hours, 'Adaptive' follows your observed search pattern.
automation_page.burst_window_hours_hint: How long at the start of day to run unpaced before switching to stretch mode.
automation_page.max_search_attempts_hint: How many times Sublarr retries a failed subtitle search before giving up.
automation_page.auto_extract_hint: Automatically extract embedded subtitles during wanted scans.
automation_page.anime_series_only_hint: Only search subtitles for anime series (skip live-action).
automation_page.anime_movies_only_hint: Only search subtitles for anime movies.
automation_page.skip_srt_no_ass: Skip SRT When No ASS Found
automation_page.skip_srt_no_ass_hint: Skip SRT subtitle downloads if no ASS subtitle was found for the episode.
automation_page.adaptive_backoff_hint: Increase retry delay exponentially for items that repeatedly fail.
automation_page.backoff_base_hint: Initial retry delay in hours when backoff is active.
automation_page.backoff_cap_hint: Maximum retry delay in hours. Delay will not exceed this value.
automation_page.upgrade_window_hint: Only upgrade subtitles downloaded within this many days.
automation_page.prefer_ass_hint: Always upgrade from SRT to ASS format when a better ASS subtitle is available.
automation_page.auto_common_fixes_hint: Apply common subtitle formatting fixes automatically after download.
automation_page.auto_hi_removal_hint: Remove hearing-impaired tags from subtitles automatically after download.
automation_page.auto_credit_removal_hint: Remove credit lines (translator notes, group ads) from subtitles automatically.
automation_page.sync_threshold_hint: Minimum subtitle score required to trigger auto-sync after download.
automation_page.sync_fallback_engine_hint: Synchronisation engine used when the primary sync attempt fails. ffsubsync is audio-based; alass is AI-based.
automation_page.nfo_export_hint: Write an NFO metadata sidecar file alongside each downloaded subtitle.
automation_page.jellyfin_translate_hint: Automatically translate subtitles when Jellyfin starts playback of a new episode.
automation_page.post_processing_enabled_hint: Runs the configured shell command after every successful subtitle download.
automation_page.post_download_command_hint: Shell command after subtitle download. Variables: {subtitle_path}, {path}, {language}, {provider}, {score}, {media_type}, {video_path}
automation_page.webhook_section_desc: Control what happens automatically when Sonarr/Radarr sends a download notification.
automation_page.webhook_delay_hint: Wait this many minutes after a Sonarr/Radarr webhook before searching.
automation_page.webhook_auto_scan_hint: Trigger a library scan automatically when a Sonarr/Radarr webhook is received.
automation_page.webhook_auto_search_hint: Trigger a subtitle search automatically when a download webhook is received.
automation_page.webhook_auto_translate_hint: Automatically translate subtitles found via a webhook-triggered search.
automation_page.cleanup_section_desc: Control which subtitles are kept during cleanup and how long deleted files are retained.
automation_page.keep_languages_hint: Comma-separated language codes to keep when cleaning up duplicates (e.g. de,en).
automation_page.keep_formats_hint: Comma-separated subtitle formats to keep during cleanup (e.g. ass,srt).
automation_page.trash_retention_hint: Keep deleted subtitles in trash for this many days before permanent removal.

scoring_tab.presets_desc: One click to apply a tuned scoring profile. Your current weights will be replaced.
scoring_tab.what_matters_desc: The most impactful settings for subtitle quality. Change these first.
scoring_tab.prefer_ass_hint: Gives a +30 score bonus to ASS and SSA subtitles over plain SRT. Recommended for anime.
scoring_tab.penalize_mt_hint: Applies a −30 score penalty to subtitles flagged as machine-translated.
scoring_tab.release_group_desc: Prefer subtitles from specific groups (score bonus) or block groups you dislike.
scoring_tab.blocked_groups_hint: Comma-separated groups to exclude from all results entirely.
scoring_tab.prefer_bonus_hint: Extra score points for subtitles matching a preferred group.
scoring_tab.mt_penalty_hint: Penalty applied to machine-translated subtitles (−50 to 0; 0 = disabled).
scoring_tab.mt_threshold_hint: Minimum confidence % (0–100) to flag a subtitle as machine-translated.

backup_tab.restore_warning: API keys will need to be re-entered after restore.

master.title: Automation
master.description: Master switch for the entire pipeline. When off, the sub-toggles below are honored individually.
master.label: Enable full automation
master.help: On: embedded subs auto-extract, SDH is a valid fallback, and foreign-language tracks can be cleaned from containers.

queue.title: Auto-Extract Queue
queue.description: Drain worker that runs until every pending embedded extract has landed on disk.
queue.enabled_help: Processes new library items automatically. Falls back to the legacy "Auto-Extract on scan" behavior when off.
queue.interval_help: Scheduler cadence. Lower = more responsive, higher = lower CPU.

sdh.title: SDH Tolerance
sdh.description: Whether SDH/CC tracks (Subtitles for Deaf / Hard-of-Hearing) are acceptable sources.
sdh.allow_help: Many Disney/Marvel rips only ship English as SDH. Keep this on unless you truly never want SDH extracted.
sdh.penalty_help: Points subtracted from SDH tracks so a non-SDH track wins a tie.

cleanup.title: Foreign-Track Cleanup
cleanup.description: After extraction succeeds, remove non-target-language subtitle tracks from the container. Backups go to the trash folder — nothing is permanently deleted.
cleanup.default_help: Global default; per-series overrides live on the series settings panel.
cleanup.keep_und_help: Preserve tracks where the language tag is "und". Leave off unless your library has unlabelled subs you want to keep.
